title: Pupil Eddie South and other students
summary: Eddie South was his pupil, talented but held back; other pupils worked in orchestras.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Learning your horn: teachers, lessons and fees

blocks.x: I was going to ask too about Eddie's South. Is he still playing around here?
Eddie... Eddie's not doing as well as he should with his talent. How's his health?
Did he have TB? You know, it's...
Now his health's fine. You'll never know that he was sick a day. He's as big as a house.
He looks fine.
By the way, he is my pupil.
Oh, is that right?
I don't know.
That's right.
You can be proud of him, I think. But there's something wrong with Eddie's makeup that's holding him back. He, as you know, he has all the talent.
Yes, I thought so too.
Very gifted, very talented. But there's something that's holding him back and it's not his music.
Yeah, it's lucky that he didn't have some health recovery anyway.
No, no, no.
One good thing.
No, because after he came out of the hospital, they put him right to work. But I don't know. He doesn't seem to...

I heard him about four years ago when he was up on the north side. Do you remember Clark Street there? I think there's State Street, about there. State Street, a little place. About state and... I don't know, Division. He played there all winter.
Yeah. He's had a few spots here where he do... He was on Rush Street. I can't think of the name of the place. Oh, yeah. Oh, but he was there possibly for four, six weeks.
Are there any other of your pupils that you can think of now that are famous, or well-known names?

Well, not as much as Eddie, because Eddie was fortunate enough to make this European tour, which really had much to do with his success, because he was a huge success at that time. But I have had quite a bit of success with most of the pupils I had at that time. But they didn't go in for concert work. They did most orchestra work. It was Jimmy Bell. And when they had the orchestra at the Regal Theatre, we had a couple of boys in there. I can't think of their names now. To get back to some of the other instruments, like on trumpet...
...and the other instruments, like on trumpet...
